license.notes: Original procedural construction. L-shaped corner module joining two wall runs at 90 degrees: leg A along +X, leg B along +Y, sharing the corner column at the pivot. Pivot at the outside corner, ground level.

dimensions_note: Ranges measured against the shipped Deli Counter library on 2026-09-11 (roadmap 64): 950 corner posts across 17 (thickness, height) pairs, thickness 0.25/0.30/0.35 m, storeys 2.7 to 6.2 m. The old height max of 4.5 excluded 252 of 988 corners; 6.5 covers the tallest shipped storey with a half-metre to spare. Width and depth are the wall thickness for a post-shaped corner and the leg lengths for an L.
